aToB.memory: Sharing Potions Class with Vivienne is an exercise in contrasting workbenches: Vivienne distills crystal-clear drafts without a hair out of place while Mina's sleeve catches three stray reagent splatters. Still, Mina admires Vivienne's scary chemical precision—especially the afternoon Vivienne slipped her an ultra-pure neutralizing drop after a capacitor boil-over without reporting it to Prof. Marlowe.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Mina wants to beg or barter two drops of Vivienne's ultra-pure stabilizing solvent before Potions Class starts—promising solemnly not to drip solder soot near her silk cuffs.

bToA.memory: Vivienne instinctively guards her silk coat whenever Mina breezes into the Potions & Alchemy Lab trailing ozone and messy ginger curls. Yet Vivienne knows better than to underestimate Mina's wild genius: beneath the soot and fast chatter lies an engineer who sees hidden patterns everyone else misses, and Mina is blissfully immune to boring social posturing.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Vivienne wants to trade Mina a spare vial of clean stabilizing reagent in exchange for a closer look at whatever intriguing Earth gadgets Mina has been quizzing newcomers about.
